{{Top|leg}}
Originally used to protect [[Starship/Legends|starship]] hulls, [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]] was the most cost-effective way to prevent the destruction of a [[Droid/Legends|droid]]. The '''dura plating Mark II''' was the heaviest mass-produced [[droid armor]] available on the open market.

==Behind the scenes==
A droid must be at upgrade class 3 to be able to equip this item.
